title: protected service routing and modular utility interfaces

specimens.name: Blind-mate connector pair
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. ONE partially mated pair of compact rectangular blind-mate electrical connector halves with rounded self-aligning guide pins, recessed protected contacts and integral flanges, no cable tails or loose pieces.

specimens.name: Panel cable feedthrough
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. ONE metal bulkhead cable feedthrough in a short thin panel fragment, with hexagonal compression gland and one short dark cable passing through the center. No connector plug, no second gland.

specimens.name: Enclosed moving cable chain
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE short curved segment of moving cable carrier with linked protective closed covers and a short guide channel under the bottom run; no exposed wires, no floor raceway or complete machine.

specimens.name: Replaceable service manifold
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE compact removable fluid distribution manifold block with three visibly different keyed capped fluid connection ports and integral mounting flange. No hoses, no solenoid valves, no electrical connectors.

specimens.name: Dry-break hose coupler
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. ONE coupled dry-break fluid hose coupling, two mated cylindrical halves with locking collar and visible mechanical safety interlock tab. Include only a short hose stub at one end, no detached parts.

specimens.name: Liquid-cooling cold plate
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. ONE small rectangular metal cooling cold plate with a corner cutaway revealing internal meandering fluid channel, two distinct fluid ports at the edge and a flat mounting face. No coolant glow, no hoses or electronic device.

specimens.name: Filter-cassette receiver
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. ONE compact rectangular receiver frame with a partly inserted removable ribbed filter cartridge and a simple retention latch. It is a serviceable mount, not a wall louver, no fan or extra cartridge.

specimens.name: Digital service port access cover
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. ONE small sealed physical access cover with a captive hinged flap open on a short mounting plate, revealing a single recessed empty diagnostic socket, gasket and small latch. No text, display, cable or entire control panel.

era_contract.character: E3 / 2015 modular spaceport utilities: protected, compact serviceable interfaces and internal cable routing, with keyed replaceable fluid hardware, off-white aluminium and graphite polymer. Finished cohesive HD pixel art.
required_signals: eight distinctly different isolated hardware examples, one per specified cell
connector and feedthrough distinguished from fluid coupler and manifold by physical interfaces
moving cable carrier is enclosed; no exposed wire bundle; passive floor cover is not a cable chain
cooling plate, filter receiver and sealed diagnostic flap have visibly different physical functions
upper-left illumination, deliberate pixel clusters and exact style bible

E2 discrete screwed round connectors transition to recessed keyed blind-mate modular connectors
E2 bulky exposed valves and utility manifolds transition to keyed replaceable service blocks and leak-safe couplings
forbidden_regressions: dense colored exposed wiring, loose patch cables and E2 diagnostic rack fragments
duplicate round hose connectors or identical housing blocks
photorealistic product catalogs and whole scenes
